audit_question: Are all 5 external providers (GitHub, Vercel, Inngest, Turso, Neon) in harmony — i.e., mutually consistent, healthy, and interoperable?
audit_answer: NO — harmony is BLOCKED. 4 of 5 providers are BLOCKED or UNVERIFIABLE. Only GitHub is VERIFIED. The production stack cannot be declared harmonious because there is no runtime evidence.
harmony_status_detail: 4 of 5 providers blocked or unverifiable. Without runtime, harmony is asserted at the schema/code level only — but runtime harmony (actual cross-provider event flow, transactional consistency, replica lag, etc.) is untestable.

evidence: HEAD 455f9d3 reachable from main branch chain
6 dangling commits preserved (reflog + object database intact)
No history rewrite, no force-push, no squash, no branch/tag deletion, no direct push to main
github.harmony_contribution: GitHub VERIFIED means source-of-truth for code is intact. Other providers can be re-integrated from GitHub if needed.

vercel.reason: No VERCEL_TOKEN provisioned in .env (template-only). Cannot access Vercel API. Cannot list deployments, cannot check production health, cannot verify whether HEAD 455f9d3 is deployed.
vercel.harmony_contribution: UNKNOWN — Vercel is the production runtime host. Without verification, harmony is asserted at code level only (Next.js build verified by `bun run lint` exit 0; build itself NOT tested).
concerns: Cannot verify production environment variables are provisioned on Vercel side (even if local .env is template-only, Vercel may have production secrets — UNVERIFIABLE from this audit)

inngest.reason: INNGEST_EVENT_KEY + INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY not provisioned in .env (template-only). Cannot enqueue events, cannot verify worker registration, cannot verify function definitions match Inngest dashboard.
inngest.harmony_contribution: BLOCKED — Inngest is the async workflow engine. Without it, no Pilot A execution, no async settlement events, no evidence chain production.
concerns: Cannot verify Inngest functions are registered

turso.reason: TURSO_DATABASE_URL + TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN not provisioned in .env (template-only). Cannot connect to Turso edge replica. Cannot verify schema matches committed prisma/schema.prisma. Cannot verify replica health.
turso.harmony_contribution: BLOCKED — Turso is the primary transactional database. Without it, no auth, no obligations, no settlement events, no mint records, no reserve policy state.
concerns: Cannot verify schema drift (live vs committed)
Cannot verify Neon replica lag (because Neon is also BLOCKED)

neon.reason: NEON_DATABASE_URL + NEON_AUTH not provisioned in .env (template-only). Cannot connect to Neon. Cannot verify analytics replica, S3 archive index, AI Gateway metadata, or KPI recalculation working set.
neon.harmony_contribution: BLOCKED — Neon is the analytics replica + evidence archive + AI Gateway. Without it, no dashboards, no KPI recalculation, no evidence-room archive, no AI model audit trail.
concerns: Cannot verify analytics replica is in sync with Turso
Cannot verify S3 archive writes succeed
Cannot verify AI Gateway metadata is captured
Cannot verify reconciliation mismatch detection works (both Turso AND Neon must be live to test reconciliation)

harmony_blocker_summary.harmony_score_detail: 1 of 5 providers VERIFIED = 0.2 harmony. Below any reasonable production-release threshold (typical minimum: 5 of 5 = 1.0).

cross_provider_harmony_checks_untestable: Inngest↔Turso event ledger write (requires both live)
Vercel↔Neon AI Gateway metadata (requires both live)
